_doc: make (CAR-V): generation of apps/car-v/car-v.csv from apps/shi-2010 and the analysis flow of the paper on it (rttools/paper/carv.py). Paths relative to apps/.

source._doc: period_s null: the shortest period of the flows of SHI2010.csv (0.04 s)

scale._doc: T = period_s (period of application E); c^(v) = cost_factor round(w(v) T_src / hyperperiod_s) + scheduler_cycles, w(v) in cycles per hyperperiod_s on the base_hz basis of shi-2010.txt; payload = floor(bytes / payload_divisor). cost_factor: the candidate of carv.choose (largest with f_CPU / clock <= max_utilization); the run evaluates every pair of cost_factor_candidates x payload_divisor_candidates.

platform._doc: clock and tick of the ORCA2 platform (pkt-sim/software/ucx-os/arch/riscv/hf-riscv-e/arch.mak: F_CLK = 500 MHz, F_TICK = 2000; tick of F_CLK / F_TICK = 250,000 cycles, hal.c TIMER1CTC = F_CPU / F_TIMER / 16 - 1, setup of the paper); f0_hz: first frequency of the search, as experiments/exp23 (make frequency); max_utilization: limit of f_CPU / clock for the choice of the cost factor, the utilization of application E (f_CPU 434.9 MHz / 500 MHz, experiments/exp23/reference_frequency.json).

memory._doc: Heap model of rttools/paper/carv.py (memory). heap_bytes: _heap_size of the weird_a.c image (make weird_a, ARCH=riscv/hf-riscv-e, build/target/image.map: 0xc62c). Struct sizes checked with riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc -march=rv32e -mabi=ilp32e (_Static_assert on sizeof).
